title: Work Map Autofix named validation diagnostics

phases.objective: Make each Work Map Autofix validation contract independently named and preserve the first failing contract in bounded diagnostic evidence before generation, commit, or push.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The workflow-dispatch-only Spec Kit Work Map Autofix writer validation step
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A validation failure identifies the exact named contract in the artifact JSON, Markdown report, and pull-request comment while generation and repository mutation remain blocked.
steps: Load the Work Map Autofix workflow without dispatching it.
Verify all eleven generator, connectivity, and classification checks are invoked through a named fail-closed contract wrapper.
Verify the first failing contract is written to bounded diagnostics.
Verify final evidence exposes the failed contract in Markdown, JSON, and the pull-request comment.
Verify validation contains no generation, push, force-push, protected-branch mutation, or external-send authority.
assertions: All eleven validation commands have stable unique names.
The first non-zero validation command records its name and exit code before returning failure.
The workflow still fails closed before generation when validation fails.
Diagnostic upload remains guarded by always().
No new trigger, permission, writer, force-push, protected-branch, database, Production, provider, credential, or external-send authority is added.
